subject: INVOKE statement
notes: Rule: 'The instance of the program, function, or method that executes the INVOKE statement is the activating runtime element.' (cite.py --check 14.9.23.4 'is the activating runtime element' -> GR1 OK). The method activation pushes a module frame whose activator is the element that executed the INVOKE (OoEmitter.EmitMethod: __ms.Push ... '§15.65.4 r5 — INVOKE is an activation'); the golden pins I-ACT=[PB36MODNAME] for a program's INVOKE and D-ACT=[SHOW] for a method's INVOKE of another method. The both-elements checking gates of GR7c (ExceptionConditionConformanceTests.OoUniversal_EnabledInActivatorOnly_StopsWithoutAttributingTheCondition) read the same activator/activated pair. || editions as adjudicated: 2002, 2014, 2023 (INVOKE / OO is a COBOL-2002 introduction)
